meaning: 创造历史，做出历史性成就
usageNote: 动词短语！说人或事件超厉害、前所未有时用，语气很燃🔥，带点史诗感！

examples.en: She made history by becoming the first woman to win the championship.
examples.zh: 她成为第一位赢得冠军的女性，创造了历史。

examples.en: The team made history with their record-breaking performance last night.
examples.zh: 这支队伍昨晚以破纪录的表现创造了历史。
